source.title: North Korea Designations; Democratic Republic of the Congo-related Designations (Recent Actions)

summary: OFAC SDN List update of 28 October 2026 covering two separate actions. First, 'Treasury Sanctions Facilitators of DPRK IT Worker Fraud Targeting U.S. Businesses' designates ten individuals (eight North Korean nationals and two Russian nationals) based in Russia/Laos under DPRK sanctions programs [DPRK2]/[DPRK3], most linked to two named entities -- FIRST FINANCIAL AND TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT CENTER and CHINYONG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COOPERATION COMPANY -- or to LLC ALIS, and several carrying listed ETH/TRX digital currency addresses. Second, 'Treasury Sanctions Rwandan Ministry of Defence and Financial Institution Supporting M23' designates the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Rwanda and Zigama Credit and Savings Society under the DRC-related program [DRCONGO] for supporting the M23 armed group. All listings carry standard secondary-sanctions-risk and U.S.-financial-institution-transaction-prohibition language under the North Korea Sanctions Regulations.

extraction_notes: This is an OFAC SDN List 'Recent Actions' bulletin covering two unrelated designation actions (DPRK IT worker fraud facilitators, and Rwanda/DRC M23 support) bundled in one release. No actors resolved against the governed register (all returned 'Unresolved'); for LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ALIS the resolver surfaced a similar name (ACT-d4e7ed33b5, 'Technological Company Fly Bridge LLC', score 0.75) as a suggestion only -- not treated as an identity. CHINYONG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COOPERATION COMPANY and LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ALIS appear in the source only as 'Linked To' tags on individual entries; the document does not give them their own full SDN entity record, so their actor citations are necessarily thin. The two emergent typologies (DPRK IT Worker Fraud Facilitation Network; Rwanda/Zigama support for M23) reflect named schemes in the press-release headers that the document does not otherwise narrate mechanically -- flagged low confidence for human review and possible consolidation with existing or future Knowledge Centre entries.
